parent_objective: design source-balanced selector over M1560 recoverable active-set pool
blocked_by: M1560 raw recoverable active-set pool is source-family concentrated
supersedes: direct history intervention design after raw M1560 pool

public_gates: M1562 must design source-balanced selection over M1560 recoverable anchors
M1562 must not rerun simulator or run history interventions
M1562 must keep selected active-set artifacts diagnostic only, not a training corpus
M1562 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1562 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a source-balanced selector over the M1560 recoverable active-set pool before history interventions
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no simulator rerun, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats selected rows as training corpus
stop if design routes directly to history interventions
stop if design does not cap source-family and window concentration
stop if design weakens recoverable-boundary criteria
fallback_plan: route to bounded selector implementation if design defines deterministic caps and gates
route back to source generation if selected count cannot meet source/window gates
route to audit if selector feasibility is ambiguous
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1561 admits a source-balanced selector design after M1560 source concentration

admission_evidence: M1561 shows a cap-based balanced subset is feasible from M1560 artifacts
allowed_updates: M1562 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up selector implementation manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1562 designs a local-control selector only and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: none in M1562; history interventions remain blocked until selected active set passes and is audited
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1562 design-only milestone over M1560 public artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-balanced selection cannot meet gates, record scenario_sampling_failure instead of weakening standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A deterministic source-balanced selector can convert M1560's raw source-concentrated recoverable pool into a balanced diagnostic active set before history interventions.
success_criteria: design specifies source-family and window concentration caps
design prioritizes strong recoverable anchors while retaining source/window diversity
design keeps selected artifacts diagnostic-only and not a training corpus
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design routes directly to history interventions training promotion private holdout or materialization
design changes actor inputs or weakens self-ID standards
design treats selected rows as a training corpus
decision_rule: M1562 passes if it designs a source-balanced selector route while preserving all no-materialization guardrails.
